scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only auth && node scripts/configure-auth.cjs && firebase deploy --only firestore,functions,database && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace functions && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace functions
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-boardgame --only auth,database,firestore,functions
scripts.test:services: node tests/auth-integration.mjs && node tests/integration.mjs && node tests/timebomb-integration.mjs && node tests/decorum-integration.mjs && node tests/splendor-integration.mjs && node tests/mafia-integration.mjs && node tests/leaderboard-integration.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-boardgame --only auth,database,firestore,functions "npm run test:services"
